Plus Two Result 2026 Kerala Out

For the academic year 2026-27, around 4.52 lakh+ students appeared for the Kerala Plus two board exams 2026 between March 6 and March 28, 2026. After the successful completion of the board exams students were eagerly waiting for the announcement of their results. So this is to inform them that their wait is finally over, as the Directorate of Higher Secondary Education (DHSE), Kerala has announced the Kerala Plus Two Exam Result 2026 on May 26, 2026 for both DHSE and VHSE at the official website keralaresults.nic.in. Students who appeared for the Class 12 Higher Secondary and Vocational examinations can now check their results using their registration number and date of birth. The mark sheets are also available digitally via DigiLocker, and further details regarding revaluation and supplementary exams will be updated on the board’s portals soon.

How to check Kerala Plus Two Result 2026 by Roll Number?

To check and download the Kerala Plus Two Result 2026 through the official DHSE, Kerala website candidates are required to follow the detailed step by step process shared below:

Step 1: Visit the official website Directorate of Higher Secondary Education (DHSE), Kerala: keralaresults.nic.in

Step 2: Click on the link that says “DHSE/VHSE Examination Results 2026”.

Step 3: In the result login window, enter your registration number and date of birth.

Step 4: Click on the “Submit” button.

Step 5: Your subject-wise marks and total score will be displayed on the screen.

Step 6: Download the provisional marksheet and take a printout for future reference.

Steps to Check Kerala DHSE Plus Two Exam Result 2026 School Wise

Step 1: Visit the official website of the Directorate of Higher Secondary Education (DHSE), Kerala at keralaresults.nic.in.

Step 2: On the homepage, click on the link titled ‘DHSE Plus Two Result 2026’.

Step 3: Look for and click on the “Plus Two School Wise Result” link.

Step 4: Enter your School Code in the login field and click on the “Submit” button.

Step 5: A new page will open displaying a list of all students from that school along with their subject-wise marks and result status.

Step 6: To quickly locate a specific student’s result, press Ctrl + F, type the student’s name or roll number, and check the result instantly.

Kerala Plus Two Marksheet 2026 PDF Digilocker Certificate

Students who appeared for the Kerala Plus Two Exam 2026 can now access their digital marksheet and passing certificate through the DigiLocker platform. The Directorate of Higher Secondary Education (DHSE), Kerala, has made the Class 12 (Plus Two) marksheets available online to facilitate secure and easy access for students. To download your Kerala Plus Two DigiLocker Certificate 2026, follow these steps:

  • Visit https://www.digilocker.gov.in or use the DigiLocker mobile app.
  • Sign in using your registered mobile number or Aadhaar linked to your DigiLocker account.
  • Navigate to the “Issued Documents” section or search for “DHSE Kerala”.
  • Select the document titled “Kerala Plus Two Marksheet 2026”.
  • Download or save the digital certificate for future use in college admissions or verification.

This digital marksheet is legally valid and equivalent to the physical copy issued by the DHSE board. In case of any discrepancy, students should contact their respective schools or DHSE officials for correction.

Kerala Plus Two Improvement (SAY) Exam 2026

The Kerala Plus Two Improvement (SAY) Exam 2026 is a second chance provided by the Directorate of Higher Secondary Education (DHSE) for students who failed in one or more subjects or wish to improve their marks in the main Plus Two exams. Eligible students can apply online by paying the prescribed subject-wise fee through the official portals such as dhsekerala.gov.in. This exam allows students to avoid losing an academic year and continue with higher education without delay.

DHSE Kerala +2 Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. When was the Kerala Plus Two Result 2026 declared?

Ans: The Kerala Plus Two Result 2026 was declared on May 26, 2026 at the official website keralaresults.nic.nic.in, dhsekerala.gov.in, pareekshabhavan.kerala.gov.in, and result.kite.kerala.gov.in.

Q2. Where can I check my DHSE Kerala Plus Two result 2026?

Ans: You can check your result on official websites such as keralaresults.nic.in, dhsekerala.gov.in, and pareekshabhavan.kerala.gov.in.

Q3. What credentials are required to check the Plus Two Result 2026?

Ans: Students need to enter their registration number and date of birth to access their results.

Q4. Can I check the Plus Two Result 2026 Kerala school wise?

Ans: Yes, school-wise results can be accessed by entering the school code through the “School-Wise Result” link on the official website.

Q5. What should I do if I fail in one or two subjects?

Ans: You can apply for the Improvement/SAY (Save A Year) Exam 2026, tentatively scheduled for June 2026.

Q6. Is there an option for revaluation of answer sheets?

Ans: Yes, students who are not satisfied with their results can apply for revaluation, scrutiny, or photocopy of answer scripts by paying a fee online.
